primary_sources.description: Assembly Bill 392 — rewrote § 835a replacing 'reasonable' with 'necessary' standard; effective January 1, 2020
Required all agencies to adopt AB 392-compliant use-of-force policies by January 1, 2021
Prior federal 'reasonable officer' standard — superseded by AB 392 for California law enforcement
Body-worn camera standards — cross-reference for footage preservation obligations

legislative_history_note: AB 392 was enacted following the March 2018 shooting of Stephon Clark by Sacramento Police. The Legislature found the prior reasonable-force standard insufficient to prevent unnecessary deaths.
